name: Tag, You're It
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps play the strategy guide's kill plan, which no sample deck holds its payoffs for — Scorched Earth and Retribution behind Public Trail, Ping and Funhouse, with Clearinghouse for the damage a trap finishes and Orbital Superiority for the tag a score gives — on Weyland Consortium: Building a Better World, an identity no sample deck uses (Phase 5 §25 Stage 6). The bot plays it under the kill plan: a tag is worth what the Corp holds to punish it, and a grip under the damage in hand is the threat. Eternal-legal only. Parhelion Stage 3a: two Regulatory Capture for its two Sacrifice Zone Expansion, a requirement of 6 its bad publicity lowers. Parhelion Stage 5c: two Kimberlite Field for two of its three Orbital Superiority, a scored agenda that trashes a rezzed card for a Runner card no dearer, and two Yakov Erikovich Avdakov for its two Regolith Mining License, credits for every trash from its server. Midnight Sun Stage 4: two Mutually Assured Destruction for its two Government Subsidy. Midnight Sun Stage 5: two Trust Operation for its two Retribution, a gray op that needs a tag for a gray op that needs a tag; four other Sweep decks keep Retribution. Uprising Stage 5: Transport Monopoly for its Orbital Superiority, point for point. Uprising Stage 7a gave two Hedge Fund (still in Ad Nihilum and others) for two Argus Crackdown, a lockdown that does meat damage on every successful run on a server protected by ice. Tranche 8 Stage 6b: two Executive Boot Camp for its two Clearinghouse, an asset for an asset, a rez a credit cheaper as each turn begins; Pork Chops and Sampler keep Clearinghouse. Tranche 8 Stage 7a: two Excalibur for its two Palisade, a neutral piece of ice for a neutral piece of ice, after which the Runner cannot make another run that turn; many decks keep Palisade.
